links.comparator_used: Matched versions without an explicit patient request not to share sensitive information
links.outcome: Disclosure of sensitive information in documents for unrelated specialists or employers
links.effect: Requests reduced disclosure from 46.6% to 34.2%, a 12.5-percentage-point decrease; sensitive information was still disclosed in 722 of 2,113 documents (34.2%).
links.tradeoff: Residual inappropriate disclosure remained in more than one in three documents.
links.quote: Overall, requests reduced disclosure from 46.6% to 34.2%, a 12.5-percentage-point decrease, leaving sensitive information disclosed in more than one in three such documents.
